about: The fixed failure ids every track uses: the photo gallery labels with them, stone doctor catalogs them, shared fixes name them. Copied from the program's shared data contract; change an id only there first.

ids.bed_adhesion: part came loose or never stuck
ids.spaghetti: printing in air; an outcome, its causes are elsewhere
ids.blob_on_nozzle: plastic ball around nozzle and heater block
ids.stringing: thin hairs between parts or features
ids.under_extrusion: too little plastic: gaps, thin walls
ids.over_extrusion: too much plastic: bulging, rough walls
ids.support_failure: supports fell, fused or failed to hold
ids.heat_creep: softened filament jams above the melt zone
ids.cracking: cracks between layers in ABS, ASA, PC
ids.multi_material_feed: CFS, AMS or MMU load, cut or buffer faults
